limitations: Ramp runs and source height profiles are pinned; width, wall dimensions, adjacent finished grades and shallow portal geometry are inferred, not an as-built survey.

One-metre Minecraft collision proxies approximate the slopes; six measured standing offsets are at most 0.520 m within gradient-derived bounds below 0.611 m.
